text.en:
1. This Act may be cited as the Finance Act 1982 and
shall have effect or be deemed to have effect as provided
in this Act.

2. The Income Tax Act 1967 and the Real Property
Gains Tax Act 1976 are amended respectively in the
manner specified in Chapters II and III.

CHAPTER II
AMENDMENTS TO THE INCOME TAX ACT 1967

3. (1) Except for section 10, the provisions of this
Chapter shall have effect for the year of assessment
1982 and subsequent years of assessment.

(2) Section 10 shall be deemed to have come into
force on the Ist January 1982.

4. Section 6B of the Income Tax Act 1967, which in
this Chapter is referred to as "the principal Act", is
amended by deleting the words "calculated on term
loan basis" appearing in subsection (1).
